The *Ajeliphaladāyakattheraapadāna* is a verse narrative preserved in the *Therāpadāna* section of the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. Cataloged under the reference Tha Ap 509, the text belongs to the class of devotional biographies recounting an elder's past meritorious action—specifically the offering of an *ajeli* fruit—and its long-term karmic fruition culminating in liberation [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral records five modern translations of the text into five languages [SuttaCentral].
